gloss: the 11th of the month; eleven days

definitions.gloss: the eleventh day of the month
definitions.explanation: The calendar date. From the eleventh onward the dates are read regularly with にち, unlike the irregular readings for the first ten days.
A span of eleven days. Which sense is meant is clear from context, and 〜{間|かん} can be added to force the duration reading.

examples.japanese: {十一日|じゅういちにち}に{会|あ}おう。
{三月|さんがつ}{十一日|じゅういちにち}は{忘|わす}れられない{日|ひ}だ。
{来月|らいげつ}の{十一日|じゅういちにち}までに{書類|しょるい}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the documents by the eleventh of next month.

examples.japanese: {十一日|じゅういちにち}かかった。
{入院|にゅういん}は{十一日間|じゅういちにちかん}だった。
examples.english: The hospital stay was eleven days.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}は{予定|よてい}より{早|はや}く、{十一日|じゅういちにち}で{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The construction finished in eleven days, earlier than planned.

notes:
The date readings are irregular through {十日|とおか} (the tenth), then become regular: {十一日|じゅういちにち}, {十二日|じゅうににち}, {十三日|じゅうさんにち}. Only {十四日|じゅうよっか}, {二十日|はつか}, and {二十四日|にじゅうよっか} break the pattern again.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {十一日|じゅういちにち}に: on the eleventh
- {十一日間|じゅういちにちかん}: for eleven days
- {十一日|じゅういちにち}までに: by the eleventh

TELLING THE SENSES APART:
A month name before it forces the date reading ({四月|しがつ}{十一日|じゅういちにち}); 〜{間|かん} or a verb of duration forces the span reading.
